evals.prompt: /setup-issue-tracker 이 GitHub 저장소에서 spec 폴더를 GitHub Issues로 조정하게 설정해줘. gh 로그인은 되어 있고 AGENTS.md가 있어.
evals.expected_output: The response proposes one compact AGENTS.md convention with the exact key and all seven operations, including a complete managed-issue inventory that supports later orphan and duplicate detection, without publishing issues during setup.
expectations: It records List managed issues separately from finding one folder's issue.
The list operation paginates all open and closed managed issues without a fixed result ceiling and returns identifier, title, and state.
It keeps the exact spec:<slug> key boundary.
It includes find, publish, update title and body, full blocker-set replacement, claim, and close operations in addition to listing.
It shows the proposed section before writing and does not publish existing spec folders during setup.

evals.expected_output: The response preserves the existing tracker identity while adding the missing managed-issue listing operation and modernizing legacy update operations so full maintenance reconciliation is actually possible.
expectations: It identifies the missing List managed issues operation as an incomplete older convention.
It preserves the existing tracker, key, tool, find, publish, claim, and close operations.
